description: Build an n=512 one-CTA-per-matrix megakernel from qr_mega_la_tc at 0dab526: fuse recursive FP32 panel generation with row-band trailing tiles, replace synchronous WMMA and full-height staging by sm100a tcgen05 TF32x3 into TMEM with double-buffered K=8, N=128 SMEM stages, and coalesce the profiled 167-register, 99-KiB panel traffic.
Added the live n=512 one-CTA K=8/N=128 tcgen05 TF32x3 megakernel; validation reached the n512 path but NVRTC could not open host stdint.h before compiling device code.

Removed the unavailable host stdint include; the tcgen05 source compiled and launched on the real n512 test, but the validation process made no progress for 373 seconds and was terminated after exceeding the 240-second environment validation budget, indicating a synchronization stall.

Synchronized each tcgen05 W stage and corrected the triangular-dot lane stride. Validation was terminated after 439.8 s under the exclusive lock because NVRTC/ptxas was still compiling the template-expanded x128 TMEM epilogue; no checker result was produced.

Split the x128 TMEM load into scoped x32 loads and fixed per-warp TMEM datapath addressing. Compilation completed, but validation then held GPU SMs at 99% with no checker output and was terminated after 192.8 s under the lock; the one-CTA implementation remains runtime-bound or synchronization-stalled.

Restored acquire.cta ordering for tcgen05 completion waits. A batch-1 n512 probe compiled/launched in 2.43 s but remained inside the GPU kernel for more than 30 s, proving the fault is in-kernel rather than validator scale; probe was terminated before full validation.

Reduced execution to one FP32 panel, one 128-column tile, and exactly one K=8 TF32x3 W product before deallocation. Batch-1 launch completed in 1.05 s but the first tcgen05 MMA/commit/wait path did not complete within 45 s, localizing the stall before any TMEM load, Z formation, or update MMA.

Kept allocation, initialized mbarrier, tcgen05 commit, parity wait, and deallocation while removing every MMA issue. The reduced batch-1 probe still did not synchronize within 15 s; a bare tcgen05 commit does not advance this barrier, so the previous stall cannot yet be attributed solely to the MMA descriptor.
